name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: THE DEFAULT EMBEDDER: 6 layers, 384 hidden, 22.7M params — the smallest model in this set. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. 384-dim output = 1.5 KB per document. This is the model everyone starts with because it is fast, small, and good enough for many use cases. The 6-layer depth means it is 2x faster than bge-small (12 layers) at the cost of some retrieval quality. Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist. The sentence-transformers library default.
